english.title: Pursuant to request knowingly cause / allow provision of a false document / information - Child Support 91
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) pursuant to a request for information under or by virtue of **(..SPECIFY THE REGULATIONS..) made under the Child Support Act 1991, caused or allowed the provision by **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE PROVIDER..) of a document or information, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DOCUMENT OR INFORMATION..), which you knew to be false in a material particular
english.legislation: Contrary to section 14A(2)(b) and (5) of the Child Support Act 1991.
